flags.why: Hi Hoàng names Fuxi alone, rather than an age associated with both Fuxi and the Yellow Emperor, as documented in this [account of Fuxi’s names](https://www.chuonghung.com/2021/07/dich-thuat-tam-hoang-ngu-e-ki-2.html).
The translation adds the Yellow Emperor, although Hi Hoàng refers to Fuxi alone ([source](https://www.chuonghung.com/2021/07/dich-thuat-tam-hoang-ngu-e-ki-2.html)).
flags.fix: The age of Fuxi survives only in legend.
